array.string: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH; LOG=/tmp/crossade-table-tunnel.log; : > $LOG; cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:2590 --no-autoupdate > $LOG 2>&1 & T=$!; trap "kill $T" EXIT; URL=; for i in $(seq 30); do sleep 1; URL=$(grep -o "https://[a-z0-9-]*\.trycloudflare\.com" $LOG | tail -1); [ -n "$URL" ] && break; done; [ -n "$URL" ] || exit 1; echo "стол снаружи: $URL/table/"; cd $HOME/Desktop/crossade-deck/server && TABLE_PUBLIC_URL=$URL PORT=2590 node --env-file=.env.table --import tsx src/index.ts
